notes.title: Fix X1.0
notes.content: reworked a lot of little moments that took me out of the environment at times. Added more lockpicks, as some players lacked them. Fixed a couple of scrimmers

notes.title: Fix -X-
notes.content: Added subtitles for the ending to make the dialogue clear. I corrected the menu and changed a couple of triggers. Thank you for improving the game with me, I’m very grateful for your participation

notes.title: Fix 2.0
notes.content: A lot of changes have been made. Most are cosmetic for more immersion in the game. Fixed the text of the notes. Changed scimitars. I will be glad to have your feedback on the game. I watch all the reviews on youtube and take all aspects of the game into consideration

notes.title: Fix 1.2
notes.content: An update that players noticed. Fully working pause menu. Candles are no longer available. I gave a hint so as not to wander for a long time. Corrected the notes. Added an additional jump scare for variety.

notes.title: Fix 1.1
notes.content: Fixed a bug with teleport. Now you can fall without fear of breaking

notes.title: Fix 1.0
notes.content: I removed unnecessary interactive captions. Fixed the front door. The key is in front of hell and the ceiling is fixed. If you have any other comments, be sure to contact us.
